decision: A6 customer-balance summary visibility for operational roles
ownerRuling: Restore historically authorized customer-balance visibility for eligible operational roles. Distinguish balance summaries from invoice details, individual payments, settlement commands and financial policy authority. Preserve company isolation, sales ownership, historical credited-salesperson/team restrictions and applicable exclusions. No new receivable write authority.
reach: The Employee's company authority (home company, OPERATIONAL company-scoped Roles, explicit company-access grants; a protected Administrator holds every company) UNION the explicit Finance company assignments (financeCompanyAccess). Non-sales roles read ALL customers' summaries inside that reach; sales roles keep self / team (eosFinance/financeVisibility.ts, inactive as deployed).

capability.objectNote: the existing payment Object (the Finance register; finance.payment.read and finance.visibility.* sit on it); a new accountBalance Object would need a seed row (capabilityGovernedObjects.json + policySeedSnapshot.json) and capabilityObjectAuthorityGuard refuses an unseeded Object

operation.name: readAccountBalanceSummary
returns: summaries[operatingCompanyId, currency, openReceivableCount, outstandingMinor, overdueCount, overdueMinor]
doesNotReturn: obligation, settlement, handoff or billing-package ids
operation.rows: open (OPEN / PARTIAL, balance outstanding) RECEIVABLE obligations of one external CRM Account; VOID and settled excluded
operation.outsideReach: reads as no data -- the same empty answer as a customer that owes nothing
operation.truncation: a visible set beyond financeVisibility.ts VISIBLE_SET_CAP answers status UNAVAILABLE; the totals themselves are summed in SQL over every row

grants.notGranted: admin, owner and the Finance roles keep their full Finance reads and receive nothing here

client.accountPage: Accounts Receivable shows the summary to a holder of finance.accountBalance.read who has no Finance workspace; full detail stays on finance.payment.read; a holder of neither keeps the 'Not available to you' placeholder (design decision A-D2)
client.adapter: domain/accountReceivablesEos.js accountArFromBalanceSummary; services/eosAccountReceivablesClient.js asks the server for the summary when the Finance workspace refuses or reaches no company
